messages:
deploybot: [AUTOMATION] Canary alert for prod-canary v3.4.0 — p95 latency spiked 2.6x, errors 6.8% (> threshold). Suggesting automated rollback to v3.3.9 in 5m unless a human overrides. Reason: KV-cache miss pattern + OOM retries in runtime logs. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/prod-canary/654321
Alice Nguyen: hold for 1 — we have 2 EU dedicated pools pinned to v3.4.0 with active customers. want to avoid a full revert without a plan.
Ben Ortiz: +1. Propose hybrid: allow auto-rollback for hosted/hosted-api traffic, keep dedicated pools pinned, and notify customers. That matches our RU and avoids churn for dedicated.
Cara Patel: sound good. Who will run the partial traffic shift and canary rollback command? Also we should update the release-notes live draft with the rollback note + reason.
Devon Li: I can run the traffic-slice. plan: 1) schedule deploybot rollback for hosted slice -> v3.3.9; 2) pin dedicated pools to keep v3.4.0; 3) run quick smoke tests.
Alice Nguyen: make sure the rollback is limited to hosted and any dynamic routing. Add a 15m hold post-rollback to validate metrics. Notify customer-success about the dedicated pin so they know we're not touching their pools.
oncall-bot: @channel ACTION: create ticket RW-9876 (rollback exec + postmortem tag) — owner: Devon Li.
Ben Ortiz: rollback command I'm going to use (devon verify):
```
# rollback hosted slice to previous model
deployctl rollout --env=prod --service=redwood-inference-hosted --target-version=v3.3.9 --traffic-slice=hosted:100 --grace-period=30s --reason="canary p95+errors"
```
Cara Patel: add this line to release-notes draft: "2026-03-21: Partial rollback for hosted API from v3.4.0->v3.3.9 due to cache-related OOM retries and elevated errors; Dedicated customers remain pinned to v3.4.0."
Devon Li: running the command now. will post logs.
deploybot: Executing rollout job id=rb-654321 now. Target: hosted slice -> v3.3.9. ETA ~2m.
Devon Li: logs:
```
[00:12:05] draining 10% traffic
[00:12:16] applied route update -> hosted:100%@v3.3.9
[00:12:50] smoke tests: ok (200/200)
```
Devon Li: smoke ok. p95 trending down. holding 15m as requested.
Alice Nguyen: ping customer-success: @cs-team heads-up — dedicated pools untouched, hosted rolled back. Draft comms in #customer-success-drafts.
Ben Ortiz: also opened a follow-up infra task to add a guard on the memory-path that tripped the OOM. RW-9877.
oncall-bot: ROLLBACK EXECUTED — rb-654321 by Devon Li. Post-rollback metrics will be monitored for 30m.
deploybot: Telemetry update: p95 baseline restored to expected range, errors down to 0.9%. No regressions in embeddings throughput observed.
Cara Patel: will update release-notes and ship a short blurb to the release channel after the 15m hold.
Alice Nguyen: thumbs. After the hold, let's schedule a short postmortem to capture root cause and follow-ups (RW-9876 + RW-9877). Thanks team. :thumbsup:
